selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms of progressive lip swelling with painful ulcerations, in combination with his HIV-1 infection and the development of symptoms after the CD4 count began to improve, support Kaposi's sarcoma as the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Herpes Simplex
rejected.why: Negative polymerase-chain-reaction assay for herpes simplex virus from an ulcer base

rejected.label: Immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS)
rejected.why: Lack of clear evidence supporting IRIS as the primary diagnosis

rejected.label: bacillary angiomatosis
rejected.why: Negative fungal blood cultures and negative urine and serum Histoplasma antigen tests
